entry.title: New: dsh-client-auto-retry
entry.summary: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning and a settings card; it never switches models or providers. Exact install spec: github:frog755/dsh-client-auto-retry. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
